gloss: to hit on; to pick up; flirting

definitions.gloss: to hit on; to pick up; to flirt with strangers
definitions.explanation: The act of approaching strangers (typically women) in public places to try to get their attention romantically.

definitions.gloss: a person who hits on others; a flirt
definitions.explanation: Someone who frequently tries to pick up strangers.

examples.english: To pick up people in Shibuya.

examples.japanese: ナンパには{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful of people trying to pick you up.

examples.japanese: ナンパ{師|し}にはなりたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to become a pickup artist.

examples.japanese: ナンパな{男|おとこ}は{信用|しんよう}できない。
examples.english: I can't trust guys who are always hitting on people.

notes:
ナンパ comes from {軟派|なんぱ}, originally meaning a "soft faction" in politics, later applied to frivolous or romantic pursuits.

REGISTER:
This is casual/colloquial language. The activity often has negative connotations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ナンパする: to hit on someone
- ナンパされる: to get hit on
- ナンパ{師|し}: pickup artist
- {逆|ぎゃく}ナン: when women hit on men (reverse nanpa)
